about: The stops the bus page's Next Buses panels watch: the places a student checks without thinking of an address. Each panel names its corner's GTFS stop ids (read by ops/transit-build.mjs, which refuses a stop the current feed does not hold). Labels are the page's own words for the corner. East Campus Mall is the BRT station's three platforms plus the two street stops on the same corner; Observatory & Walnut is the UW Hospital corner, both streets.
